name: workbuddy-delegate
description: Delegate bounded low-risk text work from Codex to an existing local WorkBuddy installation, with limits and main-agent review.

interface.longDescription: A Windows-first community plugin that routes bounded, low-risk text tasks to an existing WorkBuddy installation. Calls are isolated and usage-limited; Codex keeps final judgment.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this text task is safe to delegate.
Summarize these allowed files with WorkBuddy, then verify it.
Show WorkBuddy Delegate status and usage limits.
